What I am working on

I wanted to do something with my time, so I started learning research with a professor and building projects of my own.

Research · Data preprocessing complete · Python / NumPy / pandas / SciPy

Pre-FoG

With a professor, I am investigating whether ankle sensor data can warn of freezing of gait 1–3 seconds before it happens. The research focuses on people with Parkinson's disease who experience freezing; training data preparation is complete, while model training is still ahead.

Source code is private

Lecture Outline Mini Program

A tool for students that turns photos of lecture slides into editable study outlines. You can check the outline against the original photos and export it to Word for revision.

Source code is private

Evidence-Map

A code map for people getting started with AI-assisted coding, to help them understand their projects and find a place to make the next change. It is currently a local prototype with a file map, partial reading routes, and explanations linked to source lines.

Source code is private
